label: Application Access (Server RBAC role)
type: a Server RBAC role granting full data access to a bucket. DEPRECATED: roles.md states 'Do not grant this role to users.' Renamed - 'Versions of Couchbase Server prior to 5.5 referred to this role as Bucket Full Access' - but the internal name bucket_full_access is unchanged.
note: Promoted with the contradiction attached rather than resolved: roles.md marks it deprecated and says not to grant it, while authorization-overview.md presents it as one of Community Edition's three live fixed roles with no warning. A CE administrator is told both things. See docs-issues/server-authorization-overview-lists-deprecated-role-as-live-ce-role - needs an SME, because the honest readings diverge: either one page is stale, or CE really does depend on a deprecated role and roles.md's blanket warning has an unstated exception.
